# addr: # namer 5/8 (docs/research/naming_g5.md): semantic names need >= 2 independent evidence pieces; rows with a generic name document behaviour without asserting a purpose

name: Mobile_ResetCommandTimer
evidence: C26D=5 (timeout limit, minutes), timer B C266..C268=0, C1DA=0: arms the 5-minute command timeout checked by Mobile_CheckTimeout; called at the start of the SMTP/POP3 tasks (7 callers); 4C:417D and 4C:4467 set the same fields by hand

name: Mobile_FetchResult
evidence: MobileAPI $00 (get last result): stores A in C1DD, L/H in C1DE/C1DF; clears C2D1 (session active) unless the code is $3x, $20, $21, $24 or $26; 13 internal + 11 external callers (4C, 4E, 26, 27, 2E); 6 scenarios

name: Mobile_SessionInit
evidence: C1DB=3, C1D8=1, C1D9=0 then MobileAPI $02 (SDK Init: DE=$C271 result buffer, HL=current ROM bank from FF8A/8B); polled by Mobile_ConnectPoll which then reads the login id and e-mail address; 21 scenarios

name: Mobile_ConnectPoll
evidence: Poll (1 busy, $FF error via 54:4011, 0 done) on C1D9: 1 = API $0E login id -> C1E0, 2 = API $10 e-mail -> C201 (+ $0C dial slots -> C480 if C1D8 bit1), 3 = connect: API $3E with 'guest' login if C1D2=0 else API $06 (dial no., id, password)

name: String_Mobile_GuestLogin
evidence: ASCII "guest" NUL: copied twice after the 8-byte DNS prefix (67:5F54) as login id and password of the API $3E connect in Mobile_ConnectPoll (54:40E0-40F5); read as data in 1 scenario

name: Mobile_BeginConnect
evidence: C=dial slot selector (C1D2, 0 = guest login), HL=string copied to C220: if [C709]==1 goes straight to API $0C (dial slot -> C480, step 2) else starts SDK Init like 54:403D with C1D8=3; polled by Mobile_ConnectPoll; callers 4C:439E, 27:43AC

name: Mobile_BeginDisconnect
evidence: C1DB=3, C1D8=1, C1D9=0, MobileAPI $0A (SDK disconnect: close TCP, ISP logout, hang up); polled by Mobile_DisconnectPoll; 6 callers in 4C/27, 16 scenarios

name: Mobile_DisconnectPoll
evidence: Poll: bit0 of [C69F] busy -> 1, bit1 error -> 54:4011 and $FF, else MobileAPI $36 (SDK reset), C1D8=0 and return 0; 6 callers

name: Function_54_41C5
evidence: unreferenced: C1DB=3, C1D8=1, C1D9=0, ret, followed by an unreferenced poll that also tests [C69F] bit2 and issues MobileAPI $28/$24/$0A/$36 through the far-call sites at 41FB-4230 (entry unproven)

name: Mobile_BeginCancel
evidence: C1DB=3, C1D8=1, C1D9=0; if the SDK is busy ([C69F] bit0) or [C709]>=2 issues MobileAPI $34 (cancel/abort), else clears [C69F]; polled by Mobile_CancelPoll; 9 callers, 15 scenarios

name: Mobile_CancelPoll
evidence: Same poll pattern as 54:41A3 (busy 1 / error $FF via 54:4011 / done: MobileAPI $36 reset, C1D8=0, return 0); 9 callers after Mobile_BeginCancel

name: Http_StartGet
evidence: HL=URL, DE=receive buffer, BC=size (kept in C1D6/C1D4/C1D2), C1DB=3: Url_EnsurePath, request block at C240 (0,0, URL ptr, login id C1E0, password C220), MobileAPI $2A (SDK HttpRequestA); callers 4C:44AD (page), 4C:4945 (images)

name: Url_EnsurePath
evidence: HL=URL string: counts '/' characters; when fewer than 3 ("http://host") replaces the terminator by '/' and re-terminates; callers Http_StartGet/Http_StartPost

name: Http_StartPost
evidence: Like Http_StartGet with C1D8=3, block at C244 (C240..C243 come from the caller: body pointer, length) and MobileAPI $2C (SDK HttpRequestB); only caller 4C:4457 (body $A000 in SRAM bank 3, length from 67:6205)

name: Http_Poll
evidence: Poll for Http_StartGet/Post: busy 1; more-data bit2 re-issues API $2A/$2C; error code $32 with H=3, L=1/2 (redirect?) retried up to C1DB=3 times via Url_ResolveLocation (POST becomes GET), else $FF; 0 = reply complete

name: Url_ResolveLocation
evidence: BC=new location string (SDK result pointer): if it starts with "http://" it replaces the URL at [C1D6]; if it starts with '/' the old scheme+host is kept; else the old URL up to its last '/' is kept; the new text is appended (CopyString)

name: Mobile_BeginStop
evidence: Unless [C709]==2 issues MobileAPI $3C (SDK 'Api3C', the same call Mobile_CheckTimeout uses to stop a timed-out request); called by 4C:417D and 4C:458B when a page load is abandoned; polled by Mobile_StopPoll

name: Mobile_StopPoll
evidence: Poll after Mobile_BeginStop: busy -> 1, error -> 54:4011 and $FF, else C1D8=0 and 0

name: Mobile_CheckTimeout
evidence: Called first by every poll: timer-B minutes C268 == limit C26D -> MobileAPI $3C (C1DA=1), poll returns 1; later polls wait, then set C1DD=$26 (C1DE/F=0) and the poll returns $FF = the 5-minute timeout 26-000 of mail_timeout; 13 scenarios

name: Smtp_StartHelo
evidence: Mobile_ResetCommandTimer, C1DB=3, C1D8=1, C1D9=0, MobileAPI $14 (SDK Smtp_Helo) with HL=$C201 (own e-mail address); caller bank 26 (mail send, first step before 54:4575); 5 scenarios

name: Smtp_HeloPoll
evidence: Mobile_CheckTimeout, then busy 1 / error $FF via 54:4011 / done 0 (C1D8=0); paired with Smtp_StartHelo (26:4138 loop)

name: Smtp_StartQuit
evidence: Mobile_ResetCommandTimer, C1DB=3, C1D8=1, C1D9=0, MobileAPI $1A = SDK MobileAPI_SmtpQuit (adapter.log: QUIT on tcp:587 after the message); runs after Smtp_DataPoll in the bank-26 send phase; polled by Smtp_QuitPoll; 4 scenarios

name: Smtp_QuitPoll
evidence: Poll for Smtp_StartQuit: Mobile_CheckTimeout, UI clock tick MailSession_UpdateTimerDisplay (26:58DC), then busy 1 / error $FF via 54:4011 / done 0 (C1D8=0); 3 scenarios

name: Smtp_StartMailFrom
evidence: Outgoing mail: header block at SRAM bank3 $A100 built by Mail_BuildHeaderField (fields 6,0,3,5,7,8,10 = MIME-Version, From, To, Subject, X-Game-title, X-Game-code, Content-Type), envelope at $A000 (own address + recipient), MobileAPI $16

name: Mail_BuildHeaderField
evidence: B=outgoing header index (table 0F:4033: 0 From, 3 To, 5 Subject, 6 MIME-Version, 7 X-Game-title, 8 X-Game-code, 10 Content-Type), DE=arg block C240: mail library selector 8 (00:0247) until it stops returning $FF; advances C241/2 and C243/4

name: Function_54_4726
evidence: HL=string C=limit: counts characters up to NUL or the limit and stores the count in [C245]; callers 54:4575

name: Function_54_4736
evidence: HL=src C=limit: copies to $C580 (at most C bytes, NUL-terminated) with B = number copied; callers 54:4575

name: Function_54_4748
evidence: HL=src DE=dst: copies at most 16 bytes of a string, NUL-terminated; callers 54:4575

name: String_Mail_CloseParen
evidence: ASCII ")" NUL appended after a sender's nickname in the outgoing header (54:45D2 and 54:4644 CopyString; the " (" is written just before)

name: Smtp_DataPoll
evidence: Poll that sends the message (MobileAPI $18, SDK Smtp_Data): step 1 header block at SRAM bank3 $A100 (length C241/2, d=0), step 2 body from SRAM bank0 $A040 (max $C0) via Charset_SjisToIso2022Jp (7E:7C34) + String_Smtp_EndOfData; 4 scenarios

name: Function_54_484A
evidence: HL=string C=limit: B = length up to NUL or C; caller Smtp_DataPoll

name: String_Smtp_EndOfData
evidence: CR LF "." CR LF NUL: SMTP end-of-data marker appended to the body by Smtp_DataPoll (CopyString at 54:4809 and 54:483F)

name: Pop3_StartLogin
evidence: Mobile_ResetCommandTimer, builds "account\0password\0" at C480 from C201 and C220 and starts MobileAPI $1E (SDK Pop3_UserPass); skips it (C1D9=2) while [C6C1] bit0 is set; callers 23, 26, 2E; 12 scenarios

name: Pop3_LoginStatPoll
evidence: Poll: Mobile_CheckTimeout, UI tick 26:58DC, then step 1 starts MobileAPI $20 (SDK Pop3_Stat, DE=$C240), step 2 returns HL=[C240] (message count) with A=0; error $FF via 54:4011

name: Pop3_StartTop
evidence: HL=message number, C=mode: zeroes C480..C67F, SRAM bank 3 on, MobileAPI $28 (SDK Pop3_Top, DE=$A000, BC=$0FFF) = fetch the header of one message; polled by Pop3_TopPoll; callers 23, 26, 2E; 8 scenarios

name: Pop3_TopPoll
evidence: Poll for Pop3_StartTop; when done reads header fields with mail library selector 6 (0 From, 5 Subject, 6 Date, 10 X-Game-title, 11 X-Game-code, Charset_Iso2022JpToSjis) into a record at SRAM bank3 $B400..; B=2 if X-Game-code = CGB-BXTJ-00

name: String_Mail_DataCorrupt
evidence: Shift-JIS "メールのデータがこわれています。" ('the mail data is broken'), split in the code at 54:49E0 (first 16 bytes) and 54:49F0; shown for an unparsable message; the second sentence is String_Mail_PleaseDelete

name: String_Mail_PleaseDelete
evidence: Shift-JIS "けしてください。" ('please delete it.'), copied to $D41B by Pop3_TopPoll when a mail cannot be parsed

name: String_Mail_DefaultSource
evidence: Shift-JIS "メール" ('mail'): copied to $B430 (54:4AE9) as the source label when the X-Game-title header equals "MOBILE TRAINER" or is missing; other games put their own title there

name: String_Mail_GameTitle
evidence: ASCII "MOBILE TRAINER" NUL: prefix compared with the X-Game-title header (mail library selector 6, field $0A) of a received mail (54:4AB9 loop); equal -> String_Mail_DefaultSource

name: String_Mail_GameCodeCrystal
evidence: ASCII "CGB-BXTJ-00" (11 bytes, no NUL): compared byte for byte with the X-Game-code header at 54:4C1A; a match makes Pop3_TopPoll return B=2

name: Text_TruncateSjis
evidence: HL=string B=max bytes: walks the Shift-JIS text (lead bytes $81-$9F/$E0-$EF/$F8-$F9 take 2 bytes), and where it would exceed B cuts it and appends the ellipsis $81 $63 (Data_54_4CAD); callers 54:4A87, 4B6C

name: String_Text_Ellipsis
evidence: Shift-JIS $81 $63 (full-width ellipsis) NUL: loaded with ld hl,$4CAD by Text_TruncateSjis and appended where a name/subject is cut

name: Pop3_StartRetr
evidence: HL=message number: SRAM bank 3 on, MobileAPI $24 (SDK Pop3_Retr, DE=$A000, BC=$0FFF) = fetch the whole message; polled by Pop3_RetrPoll; callers 26; 4 scenarios

name: Pop3_RetrPoll
evidence: Poll for Pop3_StartRetr; when done: mail library selectors 1,2,4,6, Charset_Iso2022JpToSjis (7E:7D62), fills the free mail slot (2D:46E9): date +3..+8, body +9, name +$C9, subject +$D9, address +$ED; issues API $26 (delete), returns 1

name: Function_54_4FD2
evidence: Splits a From header at C580 into display name (DE) and address (HL) around '<' '>' or '(' ')', ASCII parts converted to full-width via Text_HalfToFullWidth, length-limited with 54:50FC; callers: Pop3_TopPoll (54:4A7F) and Pop3_RetrPoll

name: Function_54_50FC
evidence: HL=src DE=dst B=limit: copies a NUL-terminated string, and when the source is longer than B replaces the tail by the ellipsis $81 $63 and sets C25D=2; 7 internal callers

name: Data_Text_Ellipsis2
evidence: 2 bytes $81 $63 (Shift-JIS ellipsis) copied over the end of a clamped string by Function_54_50FC (ld hl,$511B ; ld bc,2 ; CopyBytes)

name: Function_54_511D
evidence: Mail library selectors 1 and 2 on the 3-byte argument (blob $4C44 = bank 3, $A000): E=0 when selector 1 fails, else stores B in C25F, runs selector 2 and returns E=1; used to validate/measure the mail in SRAM bank3 A000

name: Mail_ParseDate
evidence: Parses the RFC-822 date at C480 (day, month name via String_Mail_Months, year, hh:mm, zone) into BCD C580..C585 (year hi/lo, month, day, hour, minute); with a +/-hhmm zone it goes to UTC then +9 h, with carries

name: Function_54_521F
evidence: HL=text: skips characters until an ASCII digit; used by Mail_ParseDate (6 callers)

name: Function_54_522A
evidence: HL=text: skips spaces ($20); used by Mail_ParseDate

name: Function_54_5231
evidence: HL=text: returns B = number of consecutive ASCII digits; used by Mail_ParseDate

name: Function_54_5240
evidence: HL=text after the time: reads '+'/'-' hhmm zone into C590..C592 and adds/subtracts it (BCD with daa) from the parsed hour/minute, carrying into day/month/year

name: String_Mail_Months
evidence: janfebmaraprmayjunjulaugsepoctnovdec NUL: 12 lowercase 3-letter month names, compared (with |$20) against the header text at 54:51A6 to get a month index

name: Table_Mail_MonthBcd
evidence: 12 BCD month numbers 01..09,10,11,12 (byte-exact), indexed by the month index found in String_Mail_Months (54:51C2)

name: Table_Mail_DaysPerMonth
evidence: Days per month in BCD 31 28 31 30 31 30 31 31 30, six zero bytes, 31 30 31, indexed by the BCD month from $5373 so that months 10-12 hit the last three bytes (54:52B1)

name: Pop3_StartDele
evidence: A=0: clock drawn by MailServerMgr_UpdateTimerDisplay (2E:55FA), else MailSrvDel_DrawElapsedTime (23:6F00); HL=message number, Mobile_ResetCommandTimer, MobileAPI $26 (SDK Pop3_Dele); polled by Pop3_DelePoll; callers 23, 2E

name: Pop3_DelePoll
evidence: A selects the clock redraw as in Pop3_StartDele (0: 2E:55FA, else 23:6F00); Mobile_CheckTimeout, then busy 1 / error $FF via 54:4011 / done 0 (C1D8=0)
